newsitem.title: SINGAPORE: Singapore bunkers steady, South Korea competitive.
newsitem.headline: Singapore bunkers steady, South Korea competitive.

text.p: Singapore bunker indications on Wednesday were quoted within Tuesday's range amid steady enquiries, traders said.
Bunker 180-cst was quoted at $127-$128 per tonne by majors and independents and 380-cst at $123-$124 per tonne.
Traders said prices in the South Korea were very competitive, luring some volumes away from Singapore.
Some shipowners remained sidelined, expecting prices to ease when cargo prices soften. MDO prices firmed to $220-228, and gas oil to $235-$238 as cargo gas oil prices edged higher.
